note: Second signature, needed because the ground-truth Debug build never reaches the reported one. Reading the mesh output member drives LegalizeDxilInputOutputs (lib/Transforms/Scalar/ScalarReplAggregatesHLSL.cpp:6065) into `default: DXASSERT(0, "invalid input qual here")` -- the OutVertices qualifier has no case in the bLoad && bStore switch -- so a Debug build traps (0x80000003) before the module ever reaches the DXIL validator that produces the message #4307 is about. That makes the primary probe an honest invalid-probe on main-debug rather than a clean or reproducing result, and it is why this predicate exists as a separate one: same defect, different observable signature, different history. internal_failure rather than a text match, per the skill: the same failure prints a trap in Debug and nothing at all in a build with NDEBUG. Release builds compile the assert out and fall through to the validator instead -- shown directly in manual-case-release-path.txt, where `gh` steps past the trap and dxc then prints the reported message verbatim -- so releases are expected to score no-match here, silent by construction rather than fixed.
